high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "lawofomnipresence." The post features a black-and-white illustration of two individuals facing each other, with energy lines connecting them. The text at the top of the image reads: "Every time we interact with our environment there is an exchange of energy that takes place. Information is transferred as we express our thoughts, words, and emotions." The illustration shows two figures, one on the left and one on the right, both depicted in a side profile view.
